headline: Thursday Pressers
deck: João Pedro out for Chelsea with a quad injury
body: João Pedro will not play for Chelsea, ruled out by Xabi Alonso with a quad injury.

teamNews.line: Igor Thiago serves a ban, while Antoni Milambo and Josh Dasilva are over their knee and hamstring problems and came through 45 minutes for the B team.

men.name: Antoni Milambo
men.note: back from a knee injury; 45 minutes for the B team, building fitness

men.name: Josh Dasilva
men.note: back from a hamstring injury; 45 minutes for the B team, building fitness

quote.text: They played 45 minutes the other night in the B-team game. They both played well and came through the game well.

teamNews.line: Jorrel Hato, Maxence Lacroix and Reece James are all ruled out alongside João Pedro, but Moisés Caicedo has trained and returns to contention.

men.name: Maxence Lacroix
men.note: hamstring; closer to a return, not for this match

men.name: Moisés Caicedo
men.note: trained this week; expected to be okay

quote.text: It’s one less week than the last game, so we are closer to recovering, but not for this game.

teamNews.line: Leeds United have a full squad, everyone through the last match and the week's training without a fresh injury.

quote.text: As it stands, everyone’s available [and] came through the last gameday and also through the week. No injuries to report.

teamNews.line: Taiwo Awoniyi is ruled out for the weekend, the extent of his problem still to be established, and Haji Wright remains a few weeks short of a return.

men.name: Taiwo Awoniyi
men.note: unavailable for the weekend; extent not yet known

quote.text: With Haji, he’s working towards being fit, so he’s going to be a few weeks away from being available for us.
